name: Place personalized order from storefront
user_goal: As a guest buyer, personalize a product and successfully complete a purchase of it via the storefront checkout, ending in a confirmed order.

actors.permission_observed: Full access to product page personalization, add-to-cart, checkout, and order confirmation without sign-in. No signed-in buyer path was tested in this run.

entry_points.path: Storefront product page for campaign 'QA Explore Campaign PB 01' (campaign identifier 2595, inferred from Shopify SKU prefix 'lin_2595_88596' observed on the resulting order item, KB-017)
entry_points.precondition: Buyer navigates to the product page before selecting any personalization; default variant 'Vertical Framed Poster/Black/12"x18"' is pre-selected, no personalize template has a default value

capabilities.name: Select personalization template and fill dependent fields
capabilities.description: Selecting personalize template '2' reveals 7 dependent required fields (Skin Tone auto-default, 2-level Hairstyle, Woman Name text max 10 chars, 2x Cat Breed 2-level, 2x Cat Name text max 10 chars). All fields accept input, character counters update live, and the on-page mockup preview updates to reflect selections. Same template->field-set dependency corroborated by a prior observation against a different store (observed_count 2, confidence MEDIUM for the dependency shape itself).

capabilities.name: Add personalized item to cart
capabilities.description: 'Add to cart' results in exactly one cart line item carrying the campaign, chosen variant text (Color/Size), price $55.99, quantity 1, and a personalized mockup thumbnail. In cart/checkout the personalization is represented ONLY as this mockup image plus standard variant text — no readable field=value list (e.g. 'Woman Name: ...') is shown to the buyer. The request/response mechanics of the underlying POST /cart/add (variant_id, quantity, price, customization image reference) are INFERRED ONLY — no raw request/response body was captured; this must not be treated as payload/schema-verified.

capabilities.name: No per-option pricing surcharge for this template/option combination
capabilities.description: For template 2 + British fold x2 + Black hairstyle, subtotal remained the base variant price ($55.99) with no additional charge for the personalization options chosen. Corroborated by one prior observation (observed_count 2, confidence MEDIUM) — still only two data points, not a general pricing rule.

capabilities.name: Checkout: shipping method selection and test payment
capabilities.description: Checkout offers a 'Test Payment Gateway' (card digit 1=approved/2=declined/3=gateway failure, any future expiry, any 3-digit CVC) alongside real gateway options. Shipping methods observed: 'Standard' ($8.00, selected and completed) and 'Express' ($15.00, shown but never selected/completed — this price is INFERRED, not evidence-confirmed). Selecting Standard and completing checkout produces Subtotal $55.99 + Shipping $8.00 = Total $63.99 for a US/NY address, no separate tax line for that address.

capabilities.name: Receive order confirmation
capabilities.description: After submitting the Test Payment Gateway with the 'approved' card, the storefront /thank-you page shows confirmation number, 'Thank you' heading, order-confirmed message, contact/shipping/billing/payment (masked card) details, and a cost-breakdown order summary.

capabilities.name: Completed storefront order becomes visible in merchant portal
capabilities.description: A second full run of this same flow (after the user reported a webhook-config fix) resulted in an order that DID appear in the portal Orders list (portal #1002 / id 4322). This is a single successful instance and does not by itself confirm the sync issue is durably fixed — see risks[0] and the review-and-initiate-fulfillment-portal dependency.

state_transitions.trigger: select template value '2', fill 7 dependent required fields
state_transitions.condition: template selection reveals dependent field set (observed_count 2, MEDIUM)
add-to-cart mechanics themselves are INFERRED, not raw-verified
Test Payment Gateway and shipping methods (Standard confirmed, Express never completed) are presented

state_transitions.trigger: submit Test Payment Gateway, card '1' (approved), Standard shipping
state_transitions.condition: only the approved-card path was exercised; declined/gateway-failure cards never tested

state_transitions.to: order visible in portal Orders list
state_transitions.trigger: backend order-sync (webhook, mechanism not directly observed)
state_transitions.condition: OBSERVED for the second order only (KB-011); for the first order (JTEL87JY0) this transition NEVER completed and is UNRESOLVED — see risks[0] and OQ-order-001

observed_behavior.statement: Default variant and price pre-selected before any personalization ($55.99).
Template selection reveals a dependent required-field set, not a static form.
Personalization fields accept input with live character counters and live mockup preview.
Cart/checkout represent personalization via mockup image only, never as readable field=value text to the buyer.
No per-option pricing surcharge observed for the tested template/option combination.
Test Payment Gateway is available alongside real gateway(s) in this staging store.

permissions.note: Only unauthenticated guest checkout was exercised; no comparison against a signed-in buyer role exists.

portal: Orders list (order appears after sync) — KB-011
api: GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1 (used cross-layer to confirm sync, KB-011)

dependencies: Depends on the Shopify-hosted 'Test Payment Gateway' being enabled in this staging store (KB-007) — not verified as always-on infrastructure, just observed present at run time.
Downstream feature review-and-initiate-fulfillment-portal depends on the order-sync step of this feature completing successfully; that step is NOT reliable per OQ-order-001 (see risks[0]).

risks.risk: Order sync from storefront checkout into the merchant portal is unreliable / unverified as fixed.
risks.detail: One order (JTEL87JY0) placed via this exact flow never appeared in portal GET /api/orders across 90+ minutes, all statuses, both stores, and a 30-day range. A second order (PE7AU1Y53 / portal id 4322), placed after the user claimed a webhook-config fix, DID appear. Root cause was never independently verified — the fix claim is recorded as an unverified user statement, not fact. Resolution status: UNRESOLVED, decidable only by orchestrator + reviewer.

risks.risk: Add-to-cart request/response mechanics and Express shipping price are INFERRED, not raw-payload-verified.
All pricing/no-surcharge and field-dependency findings rest on 1-2 samples of one template/option combination — must not be generalized into a validation or pricing rule for other templates.

unknown_areas.question: Is the storefront->portal order sync now durably fixed, or was the second order's success a one-off?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: If unreliable, buyers could complete real purchases that merchants never see in the portal — a silent order-loss risk that should gate regression test design for this feature.

unknown_areas.question: Does the checkout flow behave the same for a signed-in buyer, other templates/personalization combinations, multi-item carts, or non-US/NY shipping addresses (tax lines)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Only one narrow combination was exercised; any checklist built from this profile should flag those as untested rather than assume parity.

unknown_areas.question: What does the Express shipping option ($15.00, never completed) actually total to, and does completing it succeed?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: The price itself is INFERRED with no supporting screenshot/dom snapshot; the full Express path was never completed end-to-end.

unknown_areas.question: What is the true shape/response of POST /cart/add, and does it ever return non-200 (e.g. sold-out variant, invalid personalization)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: No error path (4xx/5xx) was observed anywhere in this run; current knowledge only covers the happy path.

unknown_areas.question: Does the store scope decision (linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com as authoritative, not linh-explorer.myshopify.com) affect which store this profile should be considered valid for going forward?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Downstream checklist/test-data work could target the wrong store if this is not re-confirmed periodically.

profile_relationships.description: An order successfully placed by this feature is the entry precondition for review-and-initiate-fulfillment-portal's 'review and initiate fulfillment' goal. This handoff is NOT guaranteed reliable — see OQ-order-001.
